finalText:
**Redis went down and took prod with it.** One cause, not many.

| Time (UTC) | Event |
|---|---|
| 02:00–02:14 | Healthy. Cache hit ratio 0.90 to 0.98 |
| 02:14:07 | `redis connection lost: connect ECONNREFUSED 10.0.0.12:6379` |
| 02:14–02:31 | Cache off. Direct store reads. 173 `TimeoutError` at 5000ms |
| 02:15–02:31 | 13 reconnect tries, all refused. Never recovered |
| 02:31:44 | `worker-2` heap out of memory, exit 134 |
| 02:31:52 | `api unresponsive, killing process group — service down` |

Queue depth climbed steady from 52 to 568 against a max of 500. The timeouts and cache miss storms are all downstream noise.

Next: check why Redis at `10.0.0.12:6379` died. Reconnect backoff capped near 80s and gave up too calmly.
